register_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C - Cross-Stage Evidence Consistency & Forensic Reconciliation Register
register_metadata.auditor_role: Principal Quantitative Research Auditor & Governance Reviewer
register_metadata.methodology: Strict forensic distinction between historical backtest replays and synthetic software-verification tests.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Historical replays initially omitted explicit cash dividend adjustments and stock splits, causing artificial price gaps and cash distortion.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Implemented split-adjusted and dividend-adjusted price series; verified ex-date pricing conventions.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Candidate overlays (P1-P4) reported flawed overlay weight traces where cash cushion was misattributed to overlay scaling.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Constructed independent sizing oracle (v30_sizing_oracle.py) to decouple cash cushion from position sizing.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Preliminary documentation claimed Candidate P4 achieved 1.5x leveraged exposure without borrowing or cash deficits.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Mathematical audit proved gross exposure never exceeded 1.0x in cash-account simulation; claim of synthetic leverage formally retracted.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Candidate C1-C4 volatility gates claimed structural downside risk reduction across historical windows.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Demonstrated that volatility gates suffered severe whipsaw losses during 2018 false alarms, eroding CAGR. Strategy promotion blocked.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Initial analysis attributed March 2020 COVID drawdown reduction primarily to volatility trigger speed.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Factor decomposition proved drawdown reduction was driven by pre-existing defensive cash allocation (D2 cushion) rather than reactive intraday volatility switching.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Reported MaxDD for Candidate P4 was understated (-12.8% vs actual -18.4%) due to non-standard intraday interpolation.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Standardized close-to-close and high-to-low daily equity peak-to-trough calculations; corrected official MaxDD ledger.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Historical backtests presented nominal Sharpe ratios without disclosing multiple hypothesis testing penalty.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Disclosed that at least 43 historical variants were evaluated (M >= 43). Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) and Harvey-Liu-Zhu hair-cuts prove historical t-stats are inflated, mandating prospective evaluation.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Preview scripts iterated in raw emitted list order (causing buy failures when buys preceded sells), while Builderr host simulator used sell-first pass.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Host sell-first pass established as AUTHORITATIVE; order sorting enforced to guarantee 100% parity.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Event logs were initially mutable dictionary arrays vulnerable to state manipulation or missing timestamps.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Implemented HMAC-chained append-only event journals with strict monotonic sequencing and tamper detection.

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Accounting equation was formulated as NAV = Cash + Holdings + Receivables, implicitly assuming zero liabilities.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Generalized to institutional balance-sheet identity Equity = Assets - Liabilities; verified against Economic Flow Equity with Decimal oracle across 10 adversarial scenarios ($0.0000 residual).

eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.original_defect: Claimed 30 defensive sessions was fully sufficient for conclusive prospective validation.
eleven_key_forensic_reconciliations.corrective_action: Rigorous sensitivity modeling revealed N=30 yields only ~35% power under realistic variance (sigma = 80 bps/day); recommended contingent horizon extension to N >= 45-60. Clarified that 200 bps CAGR margin is an economic budget cap, not a hypothesis test.

historical_vs_synthetic_distinction.historical_replays: Run on historical market data (Tier 1 & Tier 2, 2018-2021). Suffer from lookahead risk and selection bias (M >= 43). Cannot prove future alpha.
historical_vs_synthetic_distinction.synthetic_software_verification: Run on deterministic synthetic price vectors and simulated execution events. Validates software correctness, accounting invariants, and crash safety. Does not make market profitability claims.
